description: This file defines an interface and a singleton wrapper class for interacting with GLib functions, including signal connections and loop status checks. It also declares external C functions for symbol wrapping.

classes.name: GLibWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface class for GLib functionality wrappers, allowing for different implementations.

classes.name: GLibWraps
classes.description: Singleton class providing static methods to interact with GLib, delegating to an implementation class.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance used by the GLibWraps singleton.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of GLibWraps.

methods.name: g_main_loop_is_running
methods.description: Checks if a GMainLoop is currently running.

methods.name: g_signal_connect_data
methods.description: Connects a signal handler to a GObject instance.

methods.name: signal_handlers_disconnect_by_data
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers from a GObject instance by data.

methods.name: signal_handlers_disconnect_by_func
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers from a GObject instance by function.
